lessons.lesson: A single-window result is a coin flip wearing a suit. The detector mode's 27.4% OOS drawdown reduction collapsed to 1.0% when the data window shifted by one bar.
lessons.remedy: Every advancement now must beat the current parameters on BOTH out-of-sample windows, scored at the worse one (the dual-split gate).

lessons.lesson: Pooled forward returns across mixed-scale assets lie. The elevated-vol axis looked like +9.23% vs +1.39% pooled - and won on its own scale in only 104 / 182 series. The pooled edge was high-drift crypto scale contamination, not signal.
lessons.forced_by: axis attribution across the extended universe
lessons.remedy: Own-scale beat counting: a finding must win on each series' own scale in a majority of series, not just in a pooled average.

lessons.lesson: Beautiful hypotheses die by data - and small samples lie in both directions. The 3D state-space region ideology was the most satisfying idea in the project. At 1772 pooled events it is falsified (74 / 164 own-scale beats). The axis decomposition read DEAD at the 50-series sample and WEAK majorities at the 180-series one - a reminder that a verdict is a property of the sample too - but the causal test (the v4 study) is the one that counts, and it failed: descriptive weight never converted.
lessons.forced_by: the pooled region study, axis attribution at two sample sizes, and the v4 causal study
lessons.remedy: Keep the visualization; retire the hypothesis. Falsification at n=322+ beats an eternity of hoping at n=9 - and only causal conversion can revive anything.

lessons.lesson: Deep stretch alone is the one supported entry signal - and deeper pays. On each series' own scale, deeper stretch beats the shallow edge in a majority of series at every depth, and there is no falling knife even beyond z 4 (deeper pays: True, knife: False).
lessons.remedy: Entry-threshold research now has a direction; a deeper-entry grid variant goes to the dual-split gate, not straight to belief.

lessons.lesson: Descriptive regime concentration does not survive being made causal. The mid-vol confluence lead (4/5 ETFs, descriptive) converted to a strictly causal entry rule and tested honestly null under the dual-split gate.
lessons.remedy: Description generates candidates; only causal out-of-sample conversion generates beliefs.

lessons.lesson: Search luck manufactures edges. The AVFI grid tries 84 configurations nightly; the current portfolio's OOS Sharpe 0.711 deflates to DSR 0.7834 < 0.95 - not yet separated from the search itself.
lessons.forced_by: the Deflated Sharpe Ratio (Bailey & Lopez de Prado) wired into the ledger
lessons.remedy: Every reported edge now carries its multiple-testing context. Honesty is a statistic, not a mood.

lessons.lesson: Data quality is a research finding. Expanding to top-150 crypto surfaced 33 delisted tickers and 7 junk instruments returning one-row frames - every survivor had to be verified to carry 200+ daily bars before it could enter a study.
lessons.remedy: Verified-fetch lists only; the fetcher's tolerance is for the market's mess, not for silently studying garbage.

lessons.lesson: The edge concentrates where the physics is strongest. At 156-coin depth, 19 coins pass the mean-reversion t-test - led by KMD-USD (t=-7.18, half-life 12 bars). Fast-decay series are where a z-score core has the most to work with.
lessons.remedy: The next studies (confluence, depth) run crypto-pooled, weighting where mean reversion is actually measured.

lessons.lesson: The live forward test is the only judge that cannot be fooled. Backtests selected the champion; the live paper account has run 0/20 sessions with Sharpe ~0.02 and no demonstrated edge yet. That number is not a failure - it is the only number in the project with zero selection bias.
lessons.forced_by: the deployed champion's live MTM, net of costs
lessons.remedy: Patience is part of the method: the gate demands 20 sessions and will take all 20.

lessons.lesson: Breadth generates leads; depth converts them - and the battery said no. The first positive pooled result (commodities, +0.37 OOS) went through the full honesty battery and failed it: at 2x costs the edge is zero, and deflated for 32 trials it is not separated from search luck. The direction is now depth-first: no new universes until a battery-passing edge exists.
lessons.remedy: One lead at a time, through every gate. The method is the asset; the edge has not been found yet.

lessons.lesson: Anecdotes must scale into censuses or they stay stories. The six-anecdote case file became a census of 1,461 move episodes across 532 series, and the anecdotes mostly survived: crypto UP moves start at the range bottom (72.3%), are preceded by quiet (47.2%) or a deep coil (20.9%), and only 4.2% by a blow-off - the blow-off signature belongs to the DOWN side (22.5%). Non-crypto DOWN is the mirror image (47.1% range top, hot year behind, 4.3% coiled): the forgotten-and-pinned signature is crypto's, the extended-and-exhausted signature is everyone's.
lessons.remedy: Census aggregates are descriptive context for hypothesis generation only; nothing enters the belief set without a causal test through the dual-split gate.

lessons.lesson: Multiplicity binds hardest on the biggest moves. The hundredfold board scans 303 distinct movers for the 100 largest up-moves - it finds big movers by construction, so the board can illustrate the state but can never prove an edge from its own gallery.
lessons.forced_by: the hundredfold board (hundred_moves.csv, 100 moves, one per asset)
lessons.remedy: Galleries teach the state; probabilities come only from the census's base rates with the scan disclosed.

lessons.lesson: The night-before chart never contains the move; it contains the state. All 92 night-before panels are boring - low in the yearly range, quiet, volume dried, down on the year - and that measurable state is exactly what C7 measured at +7.9 points over matched quiet. The lion never looks like a lion the night before.
lessons.forced_by: the night-before gallery (night_before.csv, 92 charts, complete state panels)
lessons.remedy: The tradable object is the state (coil depth, vol percentile, range position, stretch z, volume vs median), logged in advance - never the retrospective move.

lessons.lesson: Counter-examples are counted, not hidden. The census's crown jewel (LSK +895%/30d out of a 170-day coil, the deepest ever measured) sits in the same table as KMD +2,094%/30d with no coil and no quiet - a gallery showing only the coiled ones would be marketing.
lessons.forced_by: the census aggregates and the hundredfold board, read together
lessons.remedy: Every board publishes its base rates and its exceptions side by side; the honest counter-example gets a chart of its own.

lessons.lesson: Base rates without denominators do not predict - the composite signature failed its first causal test. The census said 72.3% of crypto up-moves start at the range bottom and 47.2% follow quiet; given the denominator the census lacked (6,767 matched state days, stride-30 sampling, 156 series), the night-before score 4-5 shows a +100%/30d hazard of 2.6% versus 3.5% for score 0-1 (z=-1.60, p=0.11) - flat across the score, flat in both time halves. The forgotten-and-pinned state does not raise the hazard of the big up-move. What the state DOES measure: protection - score 4-5 days carry roughly half the short-term crash hazard (11.1% vs 20.0% for a -30%/30d move, z=-7.29, p<0.001, stable in both halves), consistent with volatility persistence. A risk-filter reading, not a move-prediction edge.
lessons.forced_by: the night-before score test, src/night_before_test.py, first causal pass on the registry composite
lessons.remedy: The census's role is hypothesis generation, confirmed; every census reading now needs its matched-control hazard before it is repeated as if it meant something. The composite's measured value is on the downside - the next causal candidate is a risk throttle, not an entry.

lessons.lesson: The mathematics of the edge, applied in full - and the crash-protection passes. The NBS finding was put through the complete battery: Bonferroni x24 deflation (p = 1.5e-11, survives by eleven orders of magnitude), the own-scale majority that killed the elevated-vol axis (88/115 series carry the lower crash hazard in the high-score state, sign test p ~ 0, median per-series difference -10.7 points), effect size (RR 0.558, CI 0.476-0.656, NNT ~ 11), and expectancy (the median forward 30d return grades MONOTONICALLY with the score: -9.5%, -6.3%, -5.7%, -4.8%, -4.0%, -1.9%; own-scale mean wins 92/115). All three pre-declared gates pass - the first composite from the registry to carry a statistically defensible claim. Three limits recorded: it is a relative-risk filter, not profitability (medians still negative on the panel); the DSR framing fails 0.156 with a contaminated trial proxy, so the dual-split gate with a causal rule is the next arbiter; and direction remains refused - the up-side hazard is flat across the score.
lessons.forced_by: the edge-mathematics battery on the NBS crash-protection, src/nbs_edge_stats.py
lessons.remedy: The next causal candidate is now declared: a risk-throttle rule (hold through NBS>=4 states) through the dual-split gate and the forward log. Pooled means are banned on this panel - the medians and own-scale counts are the honest statistics.

lessons.lesson: A composite denominator adds information only when it is CONDITIONAL. Dividing flow by any positive measurable quantity is a monotone reparametrization - boundedness is cosmetic, no new information. The version that earns its place: divide by the effort this state usually produces (mu_NBS, sigma_NBS, trailing estimates with shrinkage), turning raw effort into state-relative surprise. Tested on 193,568 daily samples: on the up side the conditional z is MONOTONE across quintiles (18.6% to 23.9% +30%/30d hazard, separation 5.2 points vs 4.0 unconditional) - effort high FOR a coiled, quiet, forgotten asset carries more up-hazard than effort high in general. On the crash side it does not improve (2.0 vs 3.3 points): the crash reading lives in the effort level, not its surprise.
lessons.remedy: Normalize by conditional norms, never by cosmetic bounds; and test the normalization like any claim - the denominator must earn its place by improving separation, which here it does on the up side only.
